## Why visit

A compact specialist stop tucked into the arcade between the main shopping streets. Changing cask with a north-western bias sits alongside a large bottled selection, allowing a shift of style without leaving the beer-focused setting. It is a good partner to the Guest House: one delivers preserved traditional rooms, the other a small, contemporary drinks range. Include it when making Southport a full beer excursion, especially if you want something to take away as well as the day’s draught choices.

## Beer

CAMRA describes four rotating real ales and a broad bottled range; not every bottle is bottle-conditioned real ale.
